verification_targets.description: Overall extent along X (long arm length / bracket width) measured from min-X to max-X face.
verification_targets.notes: Spans X=0 (vertical arm outer face) to X=80 (free end of horizontal arm).

verification_targets.description: Overall extent along Y (common extrusion depth of both arms) measured from min-Y to max-Y face.
verification_targets.notes: Both arms share a depth of THICKNESS=8 mm in Y.

verification_targets.description: Overall extent along Z (vertical arm height) measured from Z=0 base plane to top of vertical arm.
verification_targets.notes: Absolute Z extent = VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z = 60 mm from the bottom face at Z=0.

verification_targets.description: Horizontal arm and vertical arm MUST be fused into exactly one connected solid.
verification_targets.notes: Boolean union of both arm solids; result must report exactly 1 Solid body.

verification_targets.description: Final fused solid MUST be a closed, manifold, water-tight shell with no naked edges.
verification_targets.notes: The two 6 mm through holes create interior cylindrical faces but must not break manifoldness.

functional_requirements: L-shaped mounting bracket with two mutually perpendicular arms meeting at exactly 90 degrees.
Horizontal (long) arm is 80 mm wide in X and 8 mm thick in Z; it carries the two mounting holes.
Vertical (upright) arm is 60 mm tall in Z and 8 mm thick in X, sharing the same 8 mm Y depth.
Two through holes of diameter 6 mm MUST allow clearance fasteners (M4-class) through the long arm.
Holes MUST be load-bearing in the Z (thickness) direction, i.e. penetrate the full 8 mm arm thickness.
Structural: part should remain a single rigid body under modest mounting/static loads.
special_features: The two arms MUST meet at exactly 90 degrees forming an L-profile in the XZ plane, with the vertical arm at X=0 spanning VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X=8 mm.
The horizontal (long) arm MUST span the full OVERALL_WIDTH_X=80 mm along X at Z=0..HORIZONTAL_ARM_THICKNESS_Z and share a common depth of BASE_DEPTH_Y=8 mm in Y with the vertical arm.
The vertical arm MUST rise to OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z=60 mm in Z and MUST be VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X=8 mm thick along X, its outer face flush at X=0.
Two through holes MUST be cylindrical, HOLE_DIAMETER=6 mm, penetrating the long arm fully along the Z axis (Rot identity, Cylinder axis = Z), NOT along X or Y.

The two holes MUST be centered at X=HOLE1_CENTER_X=15 and X=HOLE2_CENTER_X=65 (i.e. HOLE_END_OFFSET=15 mm from each end of the 80 mm long arm) and MUST be centered on the arm depth at Y=HOLE_CENTER_Y=4.
The two holes MUST NOT intersect the vertical arm or any outer edge; their edge distance to the arm boundary MUST be at least 3 mm.
The part MUST NOT include any features beyond the two arms and the two through holes — no fillets, chamfers, bosses, ribs, or additional cutouts unless requested.
The two holes MUST be symmetric about the XZ mid-plane of the part (equal Y offsets from Y=HOLE_CENTER_Y).
